name: Ore dake ni Bitch na Itoko wa, Yankee-kei Otoko no Ko!
original_name: 俺だけにビッチな従弟は、ヤンキー系男の娘!
source:
Shinichi Ogasawara went to his relatives' house, whom he hadn't seen for ten years to spend his summer vacation.
Finding himself in a completely remote countryside, he lost his way under the blinding brightness of sun. But suddenly a girl appeared before him, sulking for no reason. She turned out to be his male cousin, Rio Ogasawara, a person who had been in very friendly terms with Shinichi. While overcoming his perplexity at how much Rio changed all these time, he promised to reignite the intimacy between the two through pleasure of the flesh, as it was in the past.

[Adapted from game description in [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/bitterh_0021/?utm_medium=dmm_affiliate&utm_source=daingact-010]Fanza[/url]]
translation:
小笠原真一前往十年未见的亲戚家度过暑假。
他发现自己身处一个完全偏远的乡村，在耀眼的阳光下迷失了方向。但突然一个女孩出现在他的面前，无缘无故地生闷气。原来她是他的表弟小笠原里央，与新一关系非常好。虽然他对里约热内卢的变化如此之大感到困惑，但他还是答应像过去一样，通过肉体的愉悦重新点燃两人之间的亲密关系。

[改编自 [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/bitterh_0021/?utm_medium=dmm_affiliate&utm_source=daingact-010]Fanza[/url] 中的游戏描述]
